name: Famiglia CSE – site safety (Italy)
summary: 58 parametric parts for site safety on Italian road works and bridge repairs: barriers, fences, cones, temporary signs, traffic lights, flaggers, plant, cabins, site electrics.
description: Famiglia CSE v2.1 by Fabio Emolo: apprestamenti di sicurezza (LOD 300) for the safety coordinator (CSE) on the maintenance of bridges and viaducts. Every part is parametric (lengths, sizes, sign supports on a stand, a post or on the ground, mesh and shade cloth on the New Jersey barriers…) and carries the property sets CSE_Apprestamento (description, standards, footprint, unit) and CSE_Gestione4D (phase, start and end phase, WBS, zone, contractor), meant for the phase drawings of a PSC with Lapin's Phases. The signs carry the official pictograms of the Italian Highway Code's regulation (from @road-signs/it, MIT). Names and properties are in Italian. Sign layouts and the standards named are indicative: check them against the D.M. 10/07/2002 and the D.I. 22/01/2019 for the real road. Footbridge and vehicle plate sizes are drawing parameters; their capacity and fixing are the contractor's to verify.

items: Barriers: New Jersey in PE and in concrete (mesh and shade cloth optional), site fence, barrier fig. II 392, edge protection EN 13374
Crossings: pedestrian footbridge with guardrails, steel vehicle plate
Cones, raked cone tapers, flexible delineators, flashing yellow and steady red lamps
Temporary vertical signs fig. II 383–395, 31/a, 41, 45, 48, 50, 82, directional barrier II 393/a, supplementary and site panels
Temporary yellow road markings: continuous, broken, stop line, retroreflective studs
Traffic: portable traffic lights, flagger with red/green paddle, variable message trailer
Plant: under-bridge unit (working and travelling), cranes and tipper trucks, MEWP, operating vehicle, milling machine, paver, roller, truck mixer
Site services: cabins, chemical WC, container, skip, generators, lighting tower, first-aid post
Site electrics: generator, ASC board, earth rods, earth conductor, H07RN-F cable
42 CSE materials with fill colours for plans, sections and elevations
